2607.29196.title: Hy-MultiTurn: A Six-Dimensional Benchmark for Deep Multi-Turn Dialogue Understanding
2607.29196.paper_summary: Long-running multi-turn interactions with chatbots and agents are now common, and a correct response often depends on remembering earlier details, tracking later revisions, identifying intended objects or referents, and withholding action when required conditions are unmet. Existing multi-turn benchmarks typically cover short exchanges and do not fully evaluate these capabilities in long multi-turn interactions, particularly in Chinese, while offering limited insight into how and why models fail. To address these limitations, we analyze real chatbot failures to identify six recurring mechanisms and use them to define six controlled evaluation modes in Hy-MultiTurn, a Chinese benchmark for deep multi-turn dialogue understanding. The six modes evaluate constraint memory, precise execution, constraint synthesis, object localization, action suppression, and reference resolution. Across the six modes, we construct 209 controlled tasks spanning 12-76 turns, with dialogue length, irrelevant-topic distraction, and colloquial phrasing adding further difficulty. Evaluation of 22 frontier model configurations shows that Hy-MultiTurn is broadly challenging, as even GPT-5.5, the strongest overall configuration, satisfies all requirements in only 41.1 percent of responses and no model performs best in all six modes.
2607.29196.paper_summary_zh: 長期的多輪互動已經在聊天機器人和代理中變得普遍，而正確的回應往往依賴於記住早期的細節、追蹤後來的修訂、識別意圖對象或參照物，以及在所需條件未滿足時暫停行動。現有的多輪基準通常涵蓋短暫的交流，並未充分評估這些能力在長期多輪互動中的表現，特別是在中文環境下，並且對模型失敗的原因提供的見解有限。為了解決這些限制，我們分析了真實的聊天機器人失敗案例，以識別六種重複出現的機制，並利用這些機制在Hy-MultiTurn中定義六種受控評估模式，這是一個針對深度多輪對話理解的中文基準。這六種模式評估約束記憶、精確執行、約束綜合、對象定位、行動抑制和參照解析。在這六種模式中，我們構建了209個受控任務，涵蓋12到76輪對話，對話長度、無關主題的干擾和口語化措辭進一步增加了難度。對22個前沿模型配置的評估顯示，Hy-MultiTurn在整體上是具有挑戰性的，因為即使是最強的配置GPT-5.5，也僅在41.1%的回應中滿足所有要求，且沒有模型在所有六種模式中表現最佳。
